designSubsystems.label: Chassis, traction, DPU and hitch
designSubsystems.physicalInterface: Separate wheel groups, three named hitch joints, connector/merge state, clear joint envelope, and accessible driver stop.
designSubsystems.futurePB: Read wheel/joint/connector state and coordinate motion only on the local grid; no anti-jackknife controller is supplied.
designSubsystems.manualFallback: Driver steering and braking; keep the hitch clamps disengaged during travel.
designSubsystems.commissioning: Test each joint at low speed while stationary, then conduct a low-speed coupled test and record limits.

designSubsystems.label: Power generation and storage
designSubsystems.physicalInterface: Named reactors, hydrogen engine, solar panels, batteries, and local manual controls on their respective grids.
designSubsystems.futurePB: Optional measured-load sequencing and status reporting; automatic failover is not installed.
designSubsystems.manualFallback: Operate generators and batteries from terminal controls.
designSubsystems.commissioning: Measure generation, loads, charge, startup, and fuel behavior under each intended mode.

designSubsystems.label: Ore, tailings and conveyor routing
designSubsystems.physicalInterface: Named holds, sorters, ejectors, refinery/assembler ports, and inspected conveyor runs.
designSubsystems.futurePB: Optional inventory routing, quotas, jam/overflow alerts, and batch scheduling.
designSubsystems.manualFallback: Use terminal inventory transfer and sorter controls.
designSubsystems.commissioning: Test each connected path with small batches; verify ports across subgrids and connectors.

designSubsystems.label: Excavation boom and recovery tool
designSubsystems.physicalInterface: Named pedestal, five arm joints, twin tool mounts, recovery attachment, and stow interface.
designSubsystems.futurePB: Optional inverse kinematics, tool-mode sequencing, collision checks, and stow macros.
designSubsystems.manualFallback: Local joint and tool controls; macros remain disabled until explicitly enabled.
designSubsystems.commissioning: Check joint limits and clearance without load, then test tools and small loads in an open area.

designSubsystems.label: Crew circulation, pressure and life support
designSubsystems.physicalInterface: Separate pressure-testable rooms, door pairs, vents, ladders, suit supplies, and reachable manual controls.
designSubsystems.futurePB: Optional door interlocks and pressure sequencing using state actually exposed by installed blocks.
designSubsystems.manualFallback: Manual door/vent control and a suit-supported external route; no hitch passage.
designSubsystems.commissioning: Test room seals, door clearance, vent/tank behavior, and occupied-room recovery separately.

designSubsystems.label: Bridge, PB rack and machine controls
designSubsystems.physicalInterface: Three operator stations, accessible PB mounts, named local groups, displays, and physical button panels.
designSubsystems.futurePB: Local machine control on Update10; low-rate UI and network work on Update100; persist safe state in Storage.
designSubsystems.manualFallback: Driver/operator controls remain available when scripts or comms are unavailable.
designSubsystems.commissioning: Verify each control binding, PB scope, manual takeover, and loss-of-script behavior.

designSubsystems.label: Fleet communications and resupply
designSubsystems.physicalInterface: Radio/laser antennas, local C2 PBs, receiving/staging holds, and marked connector interfaces.
designSubsystems.futurePB: Use Chapter 9 channels and payloads only; unstandardized election and transfer lifecycle messages remain future work.
designSubsystems.manualFallback: Use operator-directed docking and inventory transfer.
designSubsystems.commissioning: Measure link range/line of sight and verify stationary small-batch transfers.

designSubsystems.label: Workshop and in-situ production
designSubsystems.physicalInterface: Refinery, assembler, accessible input/output holds, medical equipment, and service clearances.
designSubsystems.futurePB: Optional recipe queues, stock thresholds, and inventory reports.
designSubsystems.manualFallback: Queue production and move inventory through the terminal.
designSubsystems.commissioning: Verify recipes, conveyors, and output capacity with a small batch before automating.

designSubsystems.label: Mule and Kestrel flight operations
designSubsystems.physicalInterface: Marked pads, connectors/cradles, catwalk access, clear approach volume, and welder cutoffs.
designSubsystems.futurePB: Optional dock-state monitoring, pad sequencing, and welder enable after a compatible controller is installed.
designSubsystems.manualFallback: Manual approach, docking, undocking, and welder controls.
designSubsystems.commissioning: Begin with an empty craft and test clearance, connectors, conveyor access, and unintended-weld cutoff.

designSubsystems.label: Defense, ammunition and warning
designSubsystems.physicalInterface: Named turrets, ammunition storage/conveyors, local enable controls, and warning devices.
designSubsystems.futurePB: Optional local alert and inventory reporting; production, restock, and fleet coordination require separate logic.
designSubsystems.commissioning: Verify firing arcs and feed paths in a controlled world; destructive blocks stay absent or disarmed.

designSubsystems.label: Environmental instruments and work lighting
designSubsystems.physicalInterface: Installed vents, modded survey equipment, and adjustable work lights with accessible service points.
designSubsystems.futurePB: Optional reporting through the installed mod/controller; no native atmosphere classification or scan broadcast is assumed.
designSubsystems.manualFallback: Read local block/mod output and operate lights/vents manually.
designSubsystems.commissioning: Test the installed version in each intended environment and record actual results.

designSubsystems.label: Emergency signaling, access and separation
designSubsystems.physicalInterface: Accessible stop/abort controls, isolated beacon power, separate carriage doors, and visibly marked interfaces.
designSubsystems.futurePB: Optional alarms and state reporting; never make safe operation depend on an undocumented heartbeat.
designSubsystems.manualFallback: Independent operator stop, manual door controls, and manual separation procedure.
designSubsystems.commissioning: Test abort and power-loss paths with warheads absent/disarmed and both carriages secured.
